title: Video | Bhutan Glacial Lake Outburst | Flash Flood Warning For Assam, Bengal; Evacuations Begin - NDTV
article_text: A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) in Bhutan has triggered flash flood warnings for downstream areas in Assam and West Bengal. Overflowing water from a high-altitude lake in Bhutan's Lim Tang region is flowing towards the Mo Chhu and Sankosh river systems, raising concerns in neighbouring Indian districts. Authorities have sounded alerts, with evacuation efforts underway in vulnerable areas. Residents along the riverbanks, particularly in North Bengal's Alipurduar and Assam's Kokrajhar, have been urged to remain vigilant.

title: Video | Bhutan Glacial Lake Flood Alert | Assam Government Says 47 Missing People Are Safe - NDTV
article_text: A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) reported in Bhutan has triggered flood alerts across parts of North Bengal and lower Assam. Floodwaters are flowing downstream through the Mo Chhu and Mofu river systems towards the Sankosh. Assam authorities have activated disaster response teams and alerted riverside communities. An Assam minister said the Sankosh river level remains well below the danger mark and 47 people earlier reported missing have been traced and confirmed safe. No casualties have been reported so far.
